body:
Observed on the existing cognition-workspace receiver and original native intake requests: the X-QIKVRT-Workflow-Identity request-header field is retained in JWT form without redaction in the production invocation metadata. Samples correlate with run41288481084 jobs124794574178/124796831997; no credential value is included here, in source, or in exported evidence. Cookie fields on the same log surface are redacted. The original records must be retained; the short-lived original tokens must not be copied or reused.

The exact-source review for PR664 HEAD7c677ff66893aeca4fcb2aac397c0d1fe09422d3 was revoked by COMMENTED review5727356120 at2026-11-01T09:20:43Z and the governance status was independently read as failure. A parallel work ring nevertheless merged the source at09:21:12Z as7f571c85ee830054158eae1731e31ed12814150c. This records the observation; it does not infer the other caller's final preflight or a new natural-person instruction. The review record did not create native platform enforcement.

Repair within the existing sender/receiver and source contract: retain GitHub RS256/issuer/audience/repository/Owner/ref/workflow/run/current-Main/source/task-version/hash/CAS checks and coordination-only scope, transport the existing short-lived credential only in the explicitly source-admitted __Host-QIKVRT-Workflow-Identity cookie field, reject the old custom header and duplicate cookies, and retain the no-redirect and no-credential-forwarding rules. The app must never set this service credential for browser visitors or create a new login/session provider. The native client must reject the old transport contract before minting a token.

Close only after the exact source is integrated, the existing receiver is deployed, synthetic negative and real Workerd controls pass, and original production metadata for the new native path shows the credential field redacted with the legacy header absent. Keep issue662 separately open until the actual current-version workflow receipt and independent artifact/MCP readback exist. Neither source tests nor a changed credential field establish productive EFFECT_ACK_DONE.

Closure evidence — 2026-11-01

PR [666](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/pull/666) is integrated as `f542703ef4bdaa4d68cf2b7916f4b72fc8eae8a3`, TREE `7739ea3a26300d8016e3c07992be632fc46d6b65`. Independently read ordered parents: `768fd06415e0620dda89b1f5778db90788037e45`, `d16b9b8d574559b5decd7e2eb45473ad8f415fad`. All 42 exact-candidate native checks were terminal (26 success, 16 regular skips), all three review statuses successful. Native tested-subject artifact 13079177888 was independently downloaded: 333 bytes, SHA256 `72f1b1d1ee2a29f890b4ade48d91ea66f2ec3c773815c8a89a3d1bc96bc66869`; exact HEAD/TREE match.

Receiver version16/source `5fe510044042dab4211d5bd06f7c87e2daae318b` is deployed. Actual crypto/Workerd43, D1 18, workspace45, executor92 controls, TypeScript/provenance and compiled production smoke passed; reconciled full make test2304 executions across43 suites plus integrity passed.

The regular Main-push run [41297200232](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/41297200232), attempt1/job124820412875 used the integrated sender. Original production invocation metadata shows:
```json
[
  {
    "timestamp": 1793528557877,
    "observed_at": "2026-11-01T10:22:37.877Z",
    "path": "/api/v1/authority/tasks/REDACTED",
    "method": "GET",
    "status": 503,
    "outcome": "ok",
    "cookie_present": true,
    "cookie_redacted": true,
    "legacy_credential_header_present": false,

    "request_url_redacted": true
  },
  {
    "timestamp": 1793528557415,
    "observed_at": "2026-11-01T10:22:37.415Z",
    "path": "/api/v1/authority/tasks/REDACTED",
    "method": "GET",
    "status": 200,
    "outcome": "ok",
    "cookie_present": true,

```
The provider redacts task path/URL and Cookie value. The native intake User-Agent, matching native job stage and provider timestamps correlate these requests; the log does not expose token claims or the task ID. The HTTP200 task read demonstrates real receiver-path admission; the following503 is the separate MAIN_REF quota denial. Original record values and short-lived tokens were not exported or reused.

The native job correctly ends HOLD at `WORKSPACE_TASK_READBACK_HTTP_503_AUTHORITY_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE_UPSTREAM_MAIN_REF_HTTP_403_RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED`. Its original artifact13080131427 was independently downloaded and verified:1083 bytes, SHA256 `8f9cf04c070b0ca9c66daf7b4214340ee5a687afb086f658dc9a279be009f3f8`. This is not a successful new acceptance. No unchanged retry was triggered.

A fresh authenticated MCP readback at2026-11-01T10:25:17Z still equals the original native receipt for task `b50951b4-1194-431b-aa43-d81d262a19d3`, version8, canonical4391-byte payload SHA256 `84d282e3acc90706f7944c3db579451c0eb58aa8ed7e1486f897c465edae42dd`. The accepting actor remains run [41292736229](https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/actions/runs/41292736229), HEAD `cd05ca02206455b78816f187c1ef06243f595f1e` / TREE `9138e7685fa6b2c219ddf0d2055951cd1bc3533f`; issue662 was independently read closed.

The specific transport closure criteria are satisfied. The quota HOLD remains an independently recorded operational boundary. Productive effect and EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain false. OpenAI Codex records these independently checked effects under the existing scoped authorization; no new natural-person or independent account approval is inferred.
title: Native workload credential is unredacted in production invocation metadata
